book.title: Balua ja kabheli jaka Paulo kwa Timoseo

content: Linjolinjoli ndongwana waka Yesu Kristo
Henu, wehapa wa mwanangu, Chapanga akupekya ukangamalu mu chihomu chetupata mu kulombana na Kristo Yesu.
Na mabholu ghala ghawajowini nakatangazaje palongi ja bhalandila bhamaheli, uwapekya bhandu bhalongwana bhabhiweza kubhabhola bhandu bhangi bhelabhela.
Hinakyaje mang'ahiku papamu na nepani ngati linjolinjoli ndongwana waka Kristo Yesu.
Linjolinjoli kungondu alijepa na lihengu la matamu gha kawaida, nahuli aweza kunyambiha jola joambekiki kubha linjolinjoli.
Bhelabhela mundu joakembela na bhajaki mu imbelu, ngacheaweza kujopale nhupu ja ushindi ngati ngacheakajengali shelia ja imbelu.
Ndemi joahenga lihengu nakanopi nde joapalika kubha wa kutumbula kupata mahunu.
Holalyaje namaa ghangani ghanukupwaghila kwa ndandi Bambo anaakupekya umanyi mu mambu ghanihagha ghokapi.
Unkombukaje Yesu Kristo, joakahyokiki kuhuma kwa bhakuwa, joakabhi wa lubheleku lwaka Daude, ngati moghapwaghi Malobhi Manyahi ghandangaza.
Na kwa ndandi ndangaza Malobhi Manyahi, nepani ng'ahika na kukongakeka muchifungo ngati muhakau. Nambu Lilobhi laka Chapanga ngacheliweza kukongakeka muchifungo.
Kwa bhela nhinakila mambu ghokapi kwa ndandi ja bhahaghulika bhaka Chapanga, nahuli na bhombi bhapata ukengaleku ghoubhi muka Kristo Yesu, papamu na ulumbalilu wa mileli.
Lendenu nde lilobhi la chakaka:

content.text: kwa ndandi ngacheaweza kung'anambuka kwa ghala ghaakapwaghike.”

content: Mhenga lihengu joajetakaliwi na Chapanga

Ubhakombukya bhandu mambu ghanihagha na kubhalakalila palongi jaka Chapanga, bhakotuka kulochana panani ja malobhi ghani. Kulochana hoku ngachekupalika, nambu kuleta pena uyonangeku ukolongwa kwa bhala bhabhajowana.
Ukangamalaje kulilangi kubha ujetakaliwi na Chapanga, ngati muhenga lihengu joahenga lihengu laki koni ngachealibhone ihoni lihengu laki na ambaju abhola wichu ubholu wa chakaka waka Chapanga.
Ulijepaje na malobhi mahakau, na gha king'ang'a, maghambu kwa ghanihagha ghajonjuke kubhabheka bhandu kutali na Chapanga.
Mabholu gha ntundu ghonihoghu ghajaghanila ngati chilonda changakulama na chechikula hyegha. Pachilanda ja bhandu bhabhabholiki ghanihagha abhi Himenayo na Fileto.
Bhanihabha bhajilekiki indela ja chakaka, na kuyonanga uhobhalelu wa bhandu bhangi kwa kupwagha eti uhyoheku witu ujomwili kutendakeka.
Nambu luhuli lwaka Chapanga lujemiki kwa ukangamalu, na panani jaki palembakiki ana: “Bambo abhamanyi bhabhabhi bhaki,” na “Kila joapwagha kubha nepani nde waka Bambo na aulekaje uhakau.”

Mu nyumba ngolongwa kubhi na mbale na yombu ya kila ntundu: Yengi ilenganakiki kwa madini gha feza na zahabu, yengi ya mikongu na lutopi, yengi ya kutumika kwa utopelu na yengi kutumika panga utopelu.

Bhela anakubhi mundu aligholwili kwa kulibheka kutali kuhuma mu hyombu yela yanga utopelu, anakubha chombu cha kupata utopelu, ahaghuliwi na kunyambiha Bambo waki, na alenganakiki kwa kila lihengu lelibhi lambone.
Utilaje utokulelu uhakau wa ukombu, ukangamala kujengalela kutama ngati moapali Chapanga, uhobhalelu, upalu na lukwali papamu na bhala bhabhundoha Bambo kwa mtima wamboni.
Ulijepaje na malalukilu gha ching'ang'a na ghangakubha na ndandi, maghambu umanyi kubha ghanihagha ghaleta kulochana.
Kabheti ngacheipalika mtumika waka Bambo kubha na milomu, nambu impalika akubha mpole kwa bhandu bhokapi, joaweza kubhola na joahinakila,
abhalakalya kwa upole bhandu bhala bhabhapengana naku, nahuli ngati anaiwezakini, Chapanga abhapekya mbekenyu ja kung'anambuka na kughaleka mahoku na kuumanya uchakaka.
Panihapa maholalelu ghabhu anaghalamuka kabhete, na bhombi anabhalemikaje mu chimbenda chaka Muhakau, ambachu bhanihabha bhakapendakaliwi naku, na kubhatenda bhapata kutenda mapalu ghaki.
